name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: High-velocity procedural graph featuring continuous shed monetization, 100% hyper-fertilized Strawberry cultivation, surgical town shop arbitrage through step 710, calibrated 12-14 plot expansion, and cluster-harvest transit decongestion.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Surgical Arbitrage
nodes.description: Surgically fulfills active unlocked town shop contracts through step 710 for 2.0x-3.5x price premiums, reserving strictly required item quotas while permitting all non-contract surplus to monetize freely.

nodes.name: Active Capital Velocity & Shed Monetization
nodes.description: Maintains rapid capital velocity by executing frequent batch liquidations at 25% shed occupancy or 6+ surplus units at favorable prices (>=0.85x base), freeing continuous cash flow for seeds and fertilizer.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Strawberry Scaling
nodes.description: Directs surplus cash into the 10-hand rush, early Carrot bootstrapping transitioning into 100% hyper-fertilized recurring Strawberries, and calibrated land expansion (12-14 plots max, frozen after Day 16).

nodes.name: Cluster Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with decongested transit sequencing: cluster-harvest adjacent crops to full capacity, immediate dry plot watering, batch shed drop-off, feeding, and persistent fertilization.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (max(0, n_animals * 3)); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops strictly committed to active town shop delivery quotas.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (net_available_cash >= 180.0 or shop_deliverable_inventory > 0) and step <= 710
attributes.guidance: Allocate up to 3 market slots to deliver matching mature shed inventory directly to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premiums through step 710; reserve ONLY the exact quantity required to fulfill active unlocked shop contracts, routing all non-contract surplus directly to open-market sales; opportunistically purchase shop-demanded seeds only when contract reward justifies lead time and maturity finishes before step 710.
attributes.pitfalls: Never lock or warehouse uncontracted produce under the assumption of hypothetical future shop contracts; do not allocate seed capital to town shop crops if remaining game steps are insufficient for harvest maturity before step 710; never prematurely halt shop delivery at Day 28 when lucrative contracts can be redeemed up to step 710.

attributes.guidance: Abolish the 82% inventory freeze by executing frequent, high-velocity batch liquidations of unreserved surplus inventory; sell surplus batches (>= 6 units) when market price >= 0.85 * base_price to continuously fund seeds and fertilizer; dynamically protect ONLY exact active shop quotas and dynamic livestock feed (n_animals * 3); scale price floor down to 0.70 * base_price if shed occupancy exceeds 60%, and 0.45 * base_price only if shed_used >= 85% to absolutely prevent harvest discards.
attributes.pitfalls: Never allow uncontracted produce to accumulate past 30% shed capacity waiting for episodic flushes; never maintain phantom wheat reserves when n_animals == 0; never fire-sell below 0.70 * base_price during transient supply spikes unless shed occupancy exceeds 85%.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (>= 0.75 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.35 + 180.0 and (hired_hands < 10 or (total_plots < 14 and hired_hands >= 8 and day <= 16 and net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 2.0 + 350.0) or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 28
attributes.guidance: 1) Rush hired hands unthrottled to the 10-hand cap by early game; 2) Agronomic pivot: Plant Carrots exclusively in Days 1-2 (first 48h) as an ultra-fast cash bootstrap, then transition 100% of cultivated acreage into recurring Strawberries; 3) Enforce continuous fertilizer procurement and application for all Strawberry plots to accelerate regrow cycles and compounding yield; 4) Gate contiguous land expansion strictly: expand up to 12-14 plots maximum only when hired_hands >= 8, net cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 2.0 + plot_cost, and day <= 16 (strict Day 16 expansion freeze); 5) Halt all seed purchases after Day 26 (step 630) to avoid stranded immature crops, redirecting capital into terminal cash accumulation.
attributes.pitfalls: Never dilute cultivated plots with slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkins, Tomatoes) outside active town shop contracts; do not acquire land plots after Day 16 or when hired hands < 8; never plant unfertilized Strawberries when fertilizer is affordable; do not buy seeds when remaining game steps are insufficient for harvest maturity.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch active hands strictly by operational priority to eliminate transit waste: 1) Cluster harvest: Harvest mature crops on adjacent ready plots until worker carry capacity is full before routing to the shed; 2) Immediate watering: Water dry plots immediately to eliminate growth pauses and maintain maximum multi-harvest Strawberry regrow speed; 3) Inventory drop-off: Transport carried items to the shed once carry capacity is full or local harvest clusters are cleared; 4) Livestock feeding: Feed hungry livestock when feed is available; 5) Crop planting & persistent fertilization: Till, fertilize, and plant Strawberry seeds (Carrots on Days 1-2 only); 6) Ground maintenance: Clear weeds on cleared expansion plots. Enforce mandatory terminal inventory deposit at shed by step 714 for final market liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Never route a worker to the shed after harvesting a single crop when adjacent mature crops remain unharvested; never deprioritize watering dry crops below inventory drop-offs; never allow hands to idle while dry plots or mature crops exist; ensure hands complete shed drop-offs before step 715.
